title: VTC Credentials Reissue — payload
description: Ask a VTC to re-sign its status lists and re-issue the attestation artefacts still in force that an attestation key revoked for compromise signed, under the community's current attestation key. Re-sending the same request returns the progress of the job it started.

cause.description: The revocation that requires re-issuance. The VTC MUST verify it against its own DID's key roles (vta/webvh/dids/keys/list) rather than trust it.

verificationMethod.description: The attestation key of the community's DID that was revoked for compromise.

rotationId.description: The VTA's rotation record (`kind: compromise`) for the revocation, when known.

scope.description: `all` (the default) re-signs status lists first and then re-issues artefacts. `statusListsOnly` re-signs status lists and stops — for an operator who must restore status checking within minutes and schedule the rest.

dryRun.description: Report what would be re-signed and re-issued, without doing it. Absent reads as false.

Response.title: VTC Credentials Reissue — response payload
Response.description: Success response. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/credentials/reissue/0.1#response. Counts only — never a list of members or credentials.

jobId.description: The job this cause started. The same cause always names the same job.

state.description: `planned` — a dry run. `running` — status lists are being re-signed. `statusListsDone` — every status list is re-signed; artefacts are being re-issued (or, for `statusListsOnly`, the job is done). `completed` — everything in scope is re-signed and re-issued. `failed` — the job stopped; `artefacts.failed` and the audit trail say where.

signedWith.description: The attestation keys (verification methods) the new signatures are made with.

undeliverable.description: Artefacts re-issued but not yet delivered to their holder — the holder is offline or unreachable. They are held for the holder's next renewal or contact.
